$comment: Both guardrails run as PreToolUse hooks. A PreToolUse hook can deny a
call (permissionDecision) AND rewrite its input (updatedInput) -- the two
capabilities live in the same hookSpecificOutput block.
sdk_agent.py wires the SAME two guardrails in-process via can_use_tool.
Equal power, different expression -- see README.md.
The command never sits on the matcher. Flattening it parses fine and
Order matters: deny beats allow when several hooks apply, so the blocker
wins over the redactor on an injected payload.
